title: Check a picked via against a hole size rule
summary: Creates a temporary hole size rule with PCBRuleFactory, adds it to the board, sets absolute or percentage limits and checks one via with ActualCheck, reporting the violation; the rule must be on the board for the check to work.
phrasings: check a via drill against min and max limits
create a design rule in code
test one object against a DRC rule
let the user click a via on the board

commands.name: CheckViaHoleSize
commands.description: Check a via against a temporary hole size rule
commands.params: X=<mil>|Y=<mil> (optional; else the selected via, else a click from the menu)|MinMil=1|MaxMil=2|MinPercent=20|MaxPercent=80|Percent=true (optional)|AddViolation=false (optional)

commands.name: ListVias
commands.description: List the vias of the board with location and hole size
